Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a one-page stakeholder map based on our call. Key takeaways:

- Economic buyer: Rajesh Mehta (CFO) — will expect topline ROI and procurement cadence.
- Technical evaluators: Ava + infra/ops team — focus on latency, integrations, and logging.
- Security/legal: procurement and security will require SOC2 evidence, data flow diagram, and retention policy.

Proposed immediate next steps (suggested owners & dates):
1) Share MAP v1 (attached) — owner: Marissa — today (sent).
2) Intro to procurement/legal — owner: Samir — by EOD 11/30.
3) Security kickoff to scope evidence & timelines — owner: Neha — target week of 12/7.
4) Exec intro (Rajesh) + commercial alignment — owner: Rishi/Marissa — target week of 12/7.

Please review the attached MAP and reply with any edits. I can update and send a v2 that includes milestone dates and acceptance criteria.
